جنگل میں سکینہ رات گئے

item.text:
Audited all 16 Roman verses against the Urdu source in [baba-ko-sadaaen.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/c78fa3aa0380434da8fcece14a514cbd/src/data/lyrics/baba-ko-sadaaen.md). Changed four instances of `meiṅ` to the house spelling `mein` and verified verse and stanza alignment. The Urdu text and metadata were preserved.

Retained `ilayya` and `alam` where the Urdu spellings `الیہ` and `آلم` leave the intended readings uncertain. Those readings remain for human editorial sign-off.
